name: How much does it cost to remove a musty smell and mold?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to remove a musty smell and mold?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to remove a musty smell and mold varies significantly based on the extent of the contamination, the location of the mold (e.g., behind walls vs. visible on a surface), and the type of materials affected. Minor issues might be a few hundred dollars, while extensive mold remediation involving demolition and reconstruction can range from several thousand to tens of thousands of dollars. A professional inspection is essential for an accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on mold extent, location, and affected materials, from hundreds to tens of thousands of dollars. An inspection provides an accurate estimate.
